paragraphs: The company implements, extends and integrates Hyland OnBase content management for organizations whose work is buried in documents and cases. Its stated ground is complex environments, from court systems and departments of transportation to healthcare payers and utilities.

Document processing uses AI and machine learning to capture, classify, extract and validate data, which cuts manual keying. For courts and justice agencies the offering runs to case type specific workflows, eFiling and digital evidence management. A platform called Vault holds multimedia evidence, with device-agnostic playback, secure sharing and chain-of-custody tracking. A managed services team adds monitoring, system health checks, code reviews, upgrades and priority support.

Courts and justice agencies are among the named audiences, described as needing to reduce delays and keep cases moving. One listed deployment is a statewide e-filing platform live across more than 120 counties. For local governments, listed work includes public records requests and retention, HR workflow management, and accounts payable and receivable. It says it is backed by i3 Verticals, whose public sector software serves justice, transportation, utilities, education and public administration.

quote.text: Proven across complex environments from court systems and DOTs to healthcare payers and utilities.
